questions.example: Please confirm the SKU and quantity before we issue the purchase order.
questions.exampleZh: 請先確認品項代碼與數量，我們再開採購單。

questions.example: The new tariff will raise the landed cost of goods from that country.
questions.exampleZh: 新的關稅會提高來自該國貨物的到岸成本。

questions.example: We keep two weeks of safety stock in case of shipping delays.
questions.exampleZh: 我們保有兩週的安全庫存，以防出貨延遲。

questions.example: The supplier will ship only after they receive our letter of credit.
questions.exampleZh: 供應商要收到我們的信用狀後才會出貨。

questions.example: For this volume, FCL is cheaper than shipping several LCL loads.
questions.exampleZh: 以這個出貨量來說，整櫃海運比多票併櫃更便宜。

questions.example: Customs clearance is the bottleneck delaying our current shipments.
questions.exampleZh: 報關是目前延誤出貨的瓶頸。

questions.example: We need full lot traceability for every carton in this shipment.
questions.exampleZh: 這批貨每一箱都需要完整的批號可追溯性。

questions.prompt: 情境：你請廠商有最新進度時隨時告訴你，最自然的說法是？
options: Please keep me posted on the shipment status.
Please keep posting me the status.
questions.example: Please keep me posted on the shipment status this week.
questions.exampleZh: 本週出貨進度請隨時告訴我。

questions.prompt: 情境：你希望對方在方便時盡快回覆確認，最自然的說法是？
options: Please confirm at your earliest convenience.
Please confirm at your early convenient.
questions.example: Please confirm the revised lead time at your earliest convenience.
questions.exampleZh: 請在方便時盡快確認修訂後的交期。

questions.prompt: 情境：你寄附檔給對方當參考資料，最自然的說法是？
options: Please find the spec sheet for your reference.
I send file for you refer.
Reference you with this file please.
For you reference please the sheet.
questions.example: Please find the latest spec sheet for your reference.
questions.exampleZh: 最新規格表供您參考，請查收。
